message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep completed for the monitored product list in Products.txt, covering the last 24 hours ending with the scheduled run on 2026-06-16 05:10 IST. One high-confidence product match was found for LibreOffice. A few WordPress plugin and Ansible-family items were also published in the window, but they need environment confirmation before treating them as directly applicable.

**Finding 1: LibreOffice document parsing vulnerabilities**

- Product: LibreOffice
- Issue: Multiple newly published CVEs, including CVE-2026-6039, CVE-2026-6040, CVE-2026-8356, CVE-2026-8357, and CVE-2026-8358
- Severity: Medium / Moderate where stated by the sources. CVE-2026-8356, CVE-2026-8357, CVE-2026-8358, and CVE-2026-6040 are shown with Moderate severity / CVSS 5.4 in GitHub Advisory Database records; CVE-2026-6039 is listed as Medium by INCIBE-CERT and scored 6.3 by VulDB.
- Description: The reported issues involve crafted office or drawing files that can trigger memory-safety problems while LibreOffice imports DXF drawings, ODF number formats, legacy PPT presentations, or Calc spreadsheets.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list explicitly includes LibreOffice, and the sources name The Document Foundation / LibreOffice directly.
- Sources: NVD CVE-2026-8358 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8358; GitHub Advisory Database CVE-2026-8356 https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8r7p-3qw5-wxm5; GitHub Advisory Database CVE-2026-8357 https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j779-pcc6-8c5f; GitHub Advisory Database CVE-2026-6040 https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pp4w-c8m6-4xvf; INCIBE-CERT vulnerability listing https://www.incibe.es/en/incibe-cert/early-warning/vulnerabilities; VulDB CVE-2026-6039 https://vuldb.com/de/cve/CVE-2026-6039

**Possible matches needing review**

- Product: WordPress plugin ecosystem
- Issue: Newly published WordPress plugin CVEs including CVE-2026-8935 for WP MAPS PRO and CVE-2026-9278 for Form Builder CP
- Severity: CVE-2026-8935 is listed as Critical by Tenable/CVE feed context; severity for CVE-2026-9278 was not clearly stated in the NVD snippet reviewed.
- Description: CVE-2026-8935 describes an unauthenticated WP MAPS PRO action that can create an administrator account when a valid nonce is exposed. CVE-2026-9278 describes stored cross-site scripting in Form Builder CP for authenticated Editor-level users and above.
- Why review is needed: The monitored list includes WordPress, but these are plugin-specific findings, not WordPress core findings. They are only directly relevant if the named plugins are installed.
- Sources: NVD CVE-2026-8935 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8935; NVD CVE-2026-9278 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9278

- Product: Ansible / Ansible Lightspeed
- Issue: CVE-2026-44188
- Severity: Medium according to Red Hat / Tenable search results.
- Description: Red Hat describes an Ansible Lightspeed session-expiration weakness where an exfiltrated OAuth access token can remain usable after logout until natural expiration, allowing persistent access to the instance.
- Why review is needed: The monitored list says Ansible, but the source names Ansible Lightspeed specifically. This is relevant only if Ansible Lightspeed is part of the deployed Ansible environment.
- Sources: Red Hat CVE page https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-44188; Tenable CVE feed https://www.tenable.com/cve

**Fresh items excluded after review**

- Chrome / Chromium CVE-2026-11645, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN CVE-2026-20245, and Arista EOS CVE-2026-7473 were visible in recent CISA KEV and news results, but the credible CISA addition date was June 9, 2026, outside this 24-hour window.
- SUSE package advisories for PostgreSQL, Samba, and Erlang were surfaced on June 15 by secondary advisory listings, but their underlying SUSE release dates were earlier in June, so they were not treated as newly reported product vulnerabilities for this run.
- MongoDB, OpenSSL, Python, Microsoft Patch Tuesday, VMware, and older Chrome/Edge items found during the sweep were excluded because the primary publication dates were outside the last 24 hours or the product mapping was too indirect.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for LibreOffice exposure where users may open untrusted documents. For the WordPress and Ansible-family items, first confirm whether the named plugins or Ansible Lightspeed are deployed before escalating.
